panels.rationale: Whole-figure plate of 8 panels (A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H). A: Panel A shows histopathology of corrosion products, a key feature in adverse local tissue reaction to metallic implants. B: Panel B shows histopathology of oxidized corrosion products, a direct sign of material degradation associated with metallosis. C: Panel C depicts a cell response (giant cells) to the metallic debris, a characteristic histopathological feature of metallosis. D: Panel D shows systemic reaction to metallic corrosion products within the bone marrow, confirming the diagnosis. E: Panel E demonstrates another instance of tissue reaction to corrosion products and giant cell response. F: Panel F shows characteristic macrophage changes (foamy elements) reacting to metallic corrosion debris. G: Panel G clearly demonstrates the infiltration of debris and reaction products into the tissue. H: Panel H confirms the pathology within the hematopoietic marrow compartment.
